runs.content: Zoetis was bought at ~13x trailing earnings (vs a ~30x history) after a 45% fall; it is basing above its 52-week low with ~$2B FCF and a 2.7% yield, and is a direct Burry long (Q3 report 11-05). GEV was exited as a capacity trim at $890.33 (−8.18%, −$82; weakest position). No stop/T1/T2 triggers. Turso CLI writes worked and cleared most of the 10-19 backlog; 3 raw-SQL fixes (COP T1, MCK/AMAT dates) are still blocked. Portfolio net P&L: +$2,543 (+3.18% on $80,000).

McKesson was bought at a new 52-week high (+21.9% over 3 months) on a fiscal Q1 beat, FY27 EPS guidance of $44.20–45.00 and a CVS distribution deal in principle; it is defensive healthcare momentum outside Burry's NDX/SMH shorts. COP hit T1 at $145.24 (+26.25%, 1/3 sold for ~$421). AMAT's final third was exited at $413.11 for a blended +25.49% (+$255), after Burry's SMH puts and a missed 10-16 sector-warning breach. Turso writes are pending (blocked this run). Portfolio net P&L: +$2,147 (+2.72% on $79,000).
